title: EMV Request Data Segment
applicability: Always appears in Data Section 3 of an EMV Financial Transaction Request.
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length and cryptogram-authenticity boundary only. Detailed TLV/cross-field rules already exist in appendix-r-segment-100-coverage.json.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the EMV Request Data Segment has fixed value 130.
Segment Length identifies the EMV Request Data Segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators.
EMV Chip Data Length (Element 189) identifies the length of the following EMV Chip Data field and must be a valid 000-999 value.
CA Public Key File Checksum (Element 187) identifies the checksum received in the last CA Public Key download currently in use at host and device.

testCases.positive: EMV Chip Data Length is a valid 000-999 value matching the following field
negative: length mismatch with actual chip data

testDataStatus: Segment Type/Length and chip-data-length structural checks are synthesizable and covered. CA Public Key File Checksum authenticity requires a real production key file (see appendix-s-segment-100-coverage.json) and is EXTERNAL_FIXTURE_REQUIRED. Detailed TLV/cross-field EMV chip data rules already live in appendix-r-segment-100-coverage.json.
remaining: See appendix-r-segment-100-coverage.json for EMV chip data TLV/cross-field rules; this file intentionally does not duplicate them.
